common_label_policy: Unlabelled transactions/days are unknown, not confirmed benign. Report actual reviewed-alert denominator; do not infer false positives from all non-attack time.
selection_note: Selection is based on evidence and acquisition feasibility. Prior-exposure audit retains all three candidates with disclosed L2/L0 status; none is eligible yet. Freeze final inclusion/exclusion and monitored populations before comparing methods. One-day logs or one receipt do not establish complete historical coverage.
related_work_correction: BridgeGuard v2 reviewed 49 historical incidents, but section 3.3 describes 22 cross-chain-business-logic attacks supplying 203 labelled attack transactions. Neither 49 nor 203 is the count of independent incidents in that evaluation.

exposure_levels.L0: No historical target exposure found within explicitly audited material; not proof of global novelty.
exposure_levels.L1: Incident name/date/loss/cause in registry or aggregate statistics.
exposure_levels.L2: Label curation/exclusion metadata or unlabelled aggregate activity already processed; no targeted attack score evaluation found.
exposure_levels.L3: Target attack transaction used in training, calibration or evaluation.
exposure_levels.L4: Methods/rules/hyperparameters developed or selected using that case.
